referenceRules..btn-gold: background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gold-soft), var(--gold)); color: var(--navy);
referenceRules..card: background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 20px; box-shadow: var(--shadow);
referenceRules..hero: background: radial-gradient(1200px 400px at 80% -10%, rgba(212,175,55,.25), transparent), linear-gradient(160deg, var(--navy), var(--navy-2)); color: #fff; padding: 64px 0 72px;
referenceRules..tagline: color: var(--gold); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 3px; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: .85rem;
referenceRules..cbt: position: fixed; inset: 0; background: #f2f2f2; color: #111; z-index: 100; display: flex; flex-direction: column; font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
referenceRules..cbt-top: background: #1d3b6e; color: #fff; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 14px; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap;
